title: Remove the source-text test for TC-005 of issue #197
todo:
**Problem:** `TestBrowserProfile_Issue197_TC005_ProfileUsesTheExplicitForm` (`internal/amazon/browser_profile_values_test.go:267-311`) parses `browser.go` and compares the gofmt text of `profile()` with hard-coded strings, down to the log message of the temporary branch. It tests the shape of the source, not its behaviour. Any legitimate later edit to `profile()` (wrapping an error, renaming `directory`, rewording the log, extracting a helper) will break it. The technical specification (`doc/specifications/amazon-browser-profile/technical.md:111`) says TC-005 is covered by factory gates and review, with no test file.

**Suggested work:** Delete the test and the `go/ast`, `go/format`, `go/parser` and `go/token` imports. TC-001 to TC-003 already prove FR-AMZ-BPROF-008/009 through behaviour.

title: Drop the duplicate TC-004 stub test of issue #197
todo:
**Problem:** `TestBrowserProfile_Issue197_TC004_UndiscardableLockIsAStartFailure` (`internal/amazon/browser_profile_values_test.go:231-265`) is a stub-browser near-copy of `TestBrowserProfile_TC006_LockThatCannotBeDiscardedIsAFailure` (`internal/amazon/browser_profile_test.go:712`). The technical specification (`technical.md:110`) defines TC-004 as the existing `TestBrowserProfile_*` tests run unchanged, with no new test. Its subtest is also weaker than the original: it only asserts a failed check (the stub exits 3), not the price returned by the later check.

**Suggested work:** Remove the test and rely on the existing TC-006/TC-008 of issue #180. If the extra nil-cleanup check is worth keeping, fold it into a comment that points to TC-006 instead of duplicating the scenario.

title: Register removal of the temporary profile in the TC-003 test of issue #197
todo:
**Problem:** In `internal/amazon/browser_profile_values_test.go:210-228` (subtest "TC-003 temporary profile"), the `pricefollower-browser-*` directory created under `os.TempDir()` is removed only by the explicit `cleanup()` call on line 224. A `t.Fatal` on line 213, 216 or 222 leaves it behind.

**Suggested work:** Right after the `profileOf("")` call, add `t.Cleanup(func() { if path != "" { os.RemoveAll(path) } })`. Keep the explicit `cleanup()` call that the test asserts.
